content: Applied QA fixes to docs #2-4: core-types-traits (Entry union 14→20 variants, Tool 47 members enumerated, CommandBase 18 fields, PluginError 25 variants), auth-oauth (split auth chain to 2 parallel chains, OAUTH_BETA_HEADER NOT on token exchange, backoff is jittered constant not exponential, dual authorize URLs), state-management (category counts corrected, 2 missing fields added, Store Object.is short-circuit + onChange ordering + Set dedup, added 6th side effect)
